args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 (banker's rounding)

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.
- This change switches the quantization to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returns `2.66` (banker's rounding) as the test expects.

## Test plan
- Full test run triggered on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`; run `ci-0001` passed.
- Fixes the nightly failure in tests/test_money.py::test_half_even.

Fixes FIN-212.
